questions.question_text: Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle A onto triangle B.
Rotate triangle B through 90° clockwise with centre of rotation (1, 0). Draw this triangle and label it C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle C onto triangle A.
Complete the scatter diagram. The first four points have been plotted for you.
Write down the type of correlation shown by the scatter diagram.
Find the mean mark.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x. Give your answer in the form y = mx + c.
The value for m represents a connection between time and mark. Write down the units of m.
Use your answer to part (c)(i) to estimate the mark scored for a student who revised for 10 hours,
Use your answer to part (c)(i) to estimate the number of hours spent revising for a student to score a mark of 36.
Find, in terms of x, expressions for each of the following angles. Give each answer in its simplest form. angle BOA
Find, in terms of x, expressions for each of the following angles. Give each answer in its simplest form. angle QBO
Find, in terms of x, expressions for each of the following angles. Give each answer in its simplest form. angle CDB
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = f(x), where f(x) = 4 - |2x| for values of x between -4 and 4.
Write down the x-coordinates of the points where the graph meets the x-axis.
On the diagram, sketch the graph of y = g(x), where g(x) = 0.25x^2 for values of x between -4 and 4.
Write down the equation of the line of symmetry of the graph of y = g(x).
Find the value of the x-coordinate of each point of intersection of the two graphs.
On your diagram shade the region defined by f(x) >= g(x).
Alenia, Bob and Cara share some money in the ratio 5 : 3 : 4. Alenia's share is $1240. Show that Bob's share is $744.
Cara spends $x from her share. The ratio of Bob's money : Cara's money is now 4 : 3. Find the value of x.
A shop has a sale and all prices are reduced by 20%. Bob buys a coat. The original price of the coat was $92. Work out the sale price of the coat.
Cara buys a jacket in the sale for $132. Work out the original price of the jacket.

On 1 January 2022 Alenia buys a scooter for $1240. On 1 January 2023 the value of the scooter is reduced by 18%. On 1 January 2024 the value of the scooter is reduced by 12% of its 1 January 2023 value. Calculate the value of the scooter on 1 January 2024.
After 1 January 2024, the value of the scooter is reduced by 12% each year. Find the year in which the value of the scooter on 1 January will first be below $310.
Calculate an estimate of the mean lifetime.
Complete the cumulative frequency table.
On the grid below, draw a cumulative frequency curve.
Use your graph in part (c) to find an estimate for the median lifetime,
Use your graph in part (c) to find an estimate for the interquartile range.
Find the percentage of bulbs that have a lifetime of more than 900 hours.
Find the bearing of D from A,
Find the bearing of A from D.
Calculate AB.
Calculate CD.
Calculate the area of quadrilateral ABCD.
Angle ACD is obtuse. Find the bearing of D from C.
List the elements of set A.
Write all the elements of U in the correct parts of the Venn diagram.
List the elements of (A U B)'.
Find n((A U B) intersect C').
Find the next term and the nth term in each of the following sequences. 100, 91, 82, 73, 64, ...
Find the next term and the nth term in each of the following sequences. 64, -32, 16, -8, 4, ...
Find the next term and the nth term in each of the following sequences. -1, 8, 21, 38, 59, ...
Work out the value of P when x = -18 and y = 28, where P = ((x+3)y)/5
Simplify fully. (5y / (2x)) * (4x / 3)
Factorise fully. 15ab - 25bc
Factorise fully. 6x^2y^5 - 16x^3y^3
Factorise fully. 6cd - 3 - 9d + 2c
Make x the subject of the formula. 3ax = 1 - (2x / (a+2))
Solve the inequality. (3-x)/(2+x) > 1
A pyramid has a square base with sides of length 9 cm and vertical height h cm. Find an expression, in terms of h, for the volume of the pyramid.
ADE is an isosceles triangle. BC is parallel to DE, BC = a cm and DE = 9 cm. The vertical height of triangle ADE is h cm and the vertical height of triangle ABC is 10 cm. Show that a = 90 / h
Use Diagram 1 to find an expression, in terms of a and h, for the volume of the water.
Use Diagram 2 to find an expression, in terms of b and h, for the volume of the water.
Show that h^3 - 1000 = (h - 1)^3.
The equation h^3 - 1000 = (h - 1)^3 simplifies to h^2 - h - 333 = 0. Use a graphical method to find the value of h.
Find the probability that the three balls chosen are all green,
Find the probability that the three balls chosen are all red,
Find the probability that the three balls chosen are two red and one blue.
This experiment is to be carried out 2640 times. Use your answer from part (a)(ii) to find the expected frequency of 3 red balls being chosen.
